meta.name: hyperframes-registry
meta.description: Install, discover, and wire registry blocks and components into HyperFrames compositions. Use when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing one item or every block matching a tag, wiring an installed item into index.html, or working with hyperframes.json. Covers discovery, install locations, block sub-composition wiring, component snippet merging, and authoring a new block or component to contribute upstream (idea → scaffold → validate → PR).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 安装、发现并接入 HyperFrames 组件
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在用 HyperFrames 开发,需要装组件或开发新组件
copy.tagline_en: Install, discover, and wire HyperFrames components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build with HyperFrames and need component management or authoring

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会帮你把 HyperFrames 注册表里的积木装进项目:独立小块插入页面即可播放,特效片段直接粘进代码。还能搜索目录、安装整套积木、编写新积木提交上游。
howto.when: 当你运行 hyperframes add 或 catalog 命令、安装某个或整组积木、把积木接入 index.html 时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 hyperframes add data-chart 安装一个数据图表块
say.note: 会安装块并打印要粘贴的接入片段

say.text: 搜索一下有什么适合做字幕逐行显现效果的积木
say.note: 会按语义本地排名,结果可再安装

say.text: 把带 captions 标签的积木全部装进当前项目
say.note: 会安装该标签下的全部块

howto.what_en: Installs reusable blocks and components from the HyperFrames registry into a project, wires them into a host composition, searches the catalog, and scaffolds new items for an upstream PR.
howto.when_en: Triggers when running hyperframes add or hyperframes catalog, installing an item or every block matching a tag, wiring into index.html, or editing hyperframes.json.

say_en.text: Install the data-chart block with hyperframes add.
say_en.note: Prints written files and a snippet to paste.

say_en.text: Search for a headline reveal effect that shows one line at a time.
say_en.note: Ranks the catalog locally by meaning.

say_en.text: Install every block tagged captions in this project.
say_en.note: Installs all blocks with that tag.
